resources.usage: Static waiting/download status accent, never progress
Reserved sprite binding only; current retry uses a text button with warning status icon

consumer.authAdapter: RenderAuth -> StartupScreenViewState.FromAuth copies existing AuthGateUxState display labels only
consumer.download: Only externally supplied received/total bytes; unknown total hides bar; 100 percent remains Downloading with no completion action
consumer.update: Externally supplied version/notice only; no comparison or mandatory update policy
consumer.actions: Owner subscribes PrimaryActionRequested/SecondaryActionRequested and routes using its own authoritative state; absent owner disables buttons
consumer.lifecycle: One action per phase; owner renders Waiting then result to unlock a retry. Repeated same-phase render remains latched. Disable clears latch; reentry refreshes buttons. Owner manages async cancellation and subscriptions.
consumer.layout: Portrait 1080x1920 reference, safe area inset, 144-reference-unit button height (48px at 360 width), separate TMP text and Image fill

verification.method: Actual Camera.Render through prefab with explicit state fixtures; not real authentication/download/update evidence
